title: Launch to the bell
description: A steel ball hangs in the air at (100, 270), top left, and falls from the start. A bell hangs at (180, 150) inside a fixed box that is open only at the bottom: a roof from x = 140 to x = 220 at y = 180, and two walls at x = 140 and x = 220 from y = 130 up to the roof. The bell's bracket is 20 cm above it. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 10 to 120. Nothing can roll into the box; something has to be thrown up through its open bottom.
